title: Break A Sweat
label: Moon Harbour Recordings
chart_source: Favourite artist: Patrick Topping remix (Moon Harbour, 10 Apr 2026)
why: Patrick Topping remixing Cuartero and wAFF for Moon Harbour's 25th-anniversary series: a long, 6:50, 124 BPM groover with his trademark bouncy bass and percussion. Slower than most of today's list, so it's a great warm-up or early-peak tool.
yt_title: Cuartero & wAFF - Break A Sweat (Patrick Topping Remix) (MHR073)
notes: Official Moon Harbour upload (MHR073); 6:50 matches Beatport (6:49).

title: Love Me
label: Metamorfosi Records
chart_source: Favourite artist: Patrick Topping single (Metamorfosi, 24 Apr 2026)
why: Patrick Topping's own single on Metamorfosi: a 130 BPM vocal tech house cut with a looping 'love me' hook and a fat, rolling bassline. Pure Topping, made for the big-room peak.
notes: Topping's official upload is a 3:42 edit (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t_2I92ndITc); this PureHouseMusic repost is the full 5:33 extended (Beatport 5:32).

title: Here We Go
label: Metamorfosi Records
chart_source: Favourite artist: Patrick Topping single (Metamorfosi, 24 Apr 2026)
why: The other side of Topping's Metamorfosi single: a slightly faster, 131 BPM party roller. Pairs naturally with Love Me for a back-to-back Topping moment.
yt_title: Patrick Topping - Here We Go (Extended Mix) [METAMORFOSI RECORDS]
notes: Topping's official upload is a 3:04 edit (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ByUiyzMAgHk); this PureHouseMusic repost is the full 5:19 extended (Beatport 5:18).

title: Check This Out
label: Trick
chart_source: Favourite label: Trick (Patrick Topping), released 11 Sep 2026
why: The title track of Bruno Furlan's Trick EP (you got Me Gusta from it yesterday). The São Paulo producer brings Mochakk-style Brazilian swing to Topping's label at 131 BPM.
notes: Trick's official upload is a 2:58 edit (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kUgewsiXt4Y); this Topic upload is the full 5:54 (Beatport 5:53).

title: Party Pumpa
label: Trick
chart_source: Favourite label: Trick (Patrick Topping), released 24 Jul 2026
why: Another Trick release from the summer: a cheeky, high-energy 131 BPM party tool that does what the title says. Good for when the room needs a lift.
notes: Trick's official upload is a 2:58 edit (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yqd9azdN1D0); this Topic upload is the full 5:23 (Beatport 5:22).

title: No Brakes All Cake
label: Trick
chart_source: Favourite label: Trick (Patrick Topping), released 10 Jul 2026
why: LA duo Shaded on Trick: a punchy, swaggering 128 BPM groove with a playful vocal hook. Short and tight, so it's easy to slot between longer rollers.
notes: Official Trick Label upload; 4:16 matches Beatport (4:15). The Topic version (3:18) is an edit.

title: Double Up
label: Hot Creations
chart_source: Favourite label: Hot Creations, released 7 Aug 2026
why: Ronnie Spiteri, a regular on Hot Since 82's Knee Deep In Sound radio, back on Jamie Jones' Hot Creations with a bouncy, percussive 128 BPM groover in the classic Hot Creations mould.
notes: Official Hot Creations upload; 5:33 is the full length (Beatport 5:27).

title: Freak Me Baby
label: Hot Creations
chart_source: Favourite label: Hot Creations, released 17 Jul 2026
why: Hot Creations summer release: a sexy, chopped vocal hook over a 130 BPM groove. Exactly the vocal-sample tech house sound you love from Mochakk and PAWSA.
notes: Official Hot Creations upload (title misspells the artist as 'DuBos'); 5:09 matches Beatport (5:03).

title: Voices
label: Hot Creations
chart_source: Favourite label: Hot Creations, released 10 Jul 2026
why: Deltech on Hot Creations: a 6.5-minute, 129 BPM roller built around cut-up vocal snippets. Long intro and outro make it a great mixing tool.
notes: Official Hot Creations upload; 6:33 is the full length (Beatport 6:27). The 3:30 Topic version is an edit.

title: BodyLang
label: Hot Creations
chart_source: Favourite label: Hot Creations, released 26 Jun 2026 (F To This Beat EP)
why: Balanka (also on the Hype chart this week with Bottles) on Hot Creations: a groovy, bass-led 128 BPM cut with a body-moving swing.
notes: Official Hot Creations upload; 6:06 matches Beatport (6:00).

title: Bubbling
label: Solid Grooves Records
chart_source: Favourite label: Solid Grooves Ibiza Sampler 2026 (3 Jun 2026)
why: From PAWSA and Michael Bibi's Solid Grooves Ibiza Sampler: Dennis Cruz's bubbly, Latin-tinged 129 BPM groove with Patrick Luna's vocal. Peak Solid Grooves swing.
notes: Solid Grooves' official upload is a 3:29 edit (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XkNfVATraHw); this Topic upload is the full 5:13 extended (Beatport 5:13).

title: Playground
label: Solid Grooves Records
chart_source: Favourite label: Solid Grooves Ibiza Sampler 2026 (3 Jun 2026)
why: Arapu, who has played b2b with PAWSA at Solid Grooves' DC10 nights, with a hypnotic, rolling 129 BPM minimal-tech groover from the same Ibiza sampler.
notes: Solid Grooves' official upload is a 4:28 edit (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3MwCL0XxFPQ); this Topic upload is the full 5:57 extended (Beatport 5:57).

title: Watching Me
label: Music is blaah!
chart_source: Beatport Tech House Hype #7 / Tech House Top 100 #35
why: Climbing both the Hype chart (#7) and the main Tech House Top 100 (#35): a bright, 130 BPM A major groover with a catchy vocal hook.
notes: The label's official upload is a 3:13 edit (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sh3l2qDuolk); this Topic upload is the full 5:40 extended (Beatport 5:39).

title: Take Our Time
label: Sound D’Elite
chart_source: Beatport Tech House Hype #9 / Tech House Top 100 #41
why: Top 10 on the Hype chart: Chico Rose's 6.5-minute, 129 BPM F minor cut on Sound D'Elite. Groovy, vocal-led and long enough for smooth blends.
yt_title: Chico Rose (NL) - Take Our Time (Extended Mix)
notes: Uploaded by Grroov; 6:32 matches Beatport (6:31). The artist's own 4:07 upload is an edit.

label: Chaste Records
chart_source: Beatport Tech House Hype #11 / Tech House Top 100 #51
why: KinAhau and WIFE MATERIAL's MC-style 'ladies and gentlemen' call-out over a 130 BPM E major groove. A crowd-hyping moment on the Hype chart right now.
notes: Official Topic upload; 5:27 matches Beatport (5:26).

label: range.
chart_source: Beatport Tech House Hype #19

notes: Official 'natural range.' label upload; 6:21 matches Beatport (6:20).

title: Panteras
label: Cecille
chart_source: Beatport House Top 100 #31
why: Reboot (who has 'Haha' coming on Solid Grooves Raw on 9 Oct) with Carloh on Cecille: a percussive, Latin-flavoured 130 BPM roller sitting in the House Top 40.
notes: Official Topic upload; 6:16 matches Beatport. There is also a 3:01 edit on the same channel.

title: Funky Feeling
label: LTF Records
chart_source: Beatport House Top 100 #29
why: A funky, 129 BPM jacking house cut that lives up to its title; one for when you just want to dance.
notes: Uploaded by Altra Moda Music; 5:16 matches the Beatport extended. The 3:18 Topic upload is an edit.

title: Take Them Back
label: BINARY
chart_source: Beatport Minimal / Deep Tech Top 100 #21 (new 24 Sep)
why: Brand new (24 Sep) and already #21 in Minimal / Deep Tech: a 130 BPM UK minimal-tech roller with a bouncy, swung groove. Great alongside your minimal-tech seed list.
notes: Official Topic upload; 5:47 matches Beatport. Avoid the 4:43 'Unreleased ID' rip.

title: I Met Her Last Summer
label: Freerange Records
chart_source: Beatport Deep House Top 100 #5
why: #5 in Deep House: Dutch duo Dam Swindle on Jimpster's Freerange label with a warm, soulful 123 BPM groove. A sunset track with that slightly quirky, heartfelt feel you liked in 'Stand Still'.
yt_title: Dam Swindle - I Met Her Last Summer (Original Mix)
notes: Uploaded by VeryHouseMusic; 6:32 matches Beatport. The 5:29 'Release - Topic' upload is shorter.

chart_source: Beatport Techno (Peak Time / Driving) Top 100 #16

notes: Official Topic upload; 6:43 matches Beatport.

title: K.O.
label: Drumcode
chart_source: Beatport Techno (Peak Time / Driving) Top 100 #19
why: Oliver Huntemann and Kaufmann on Adam Beyer's Drumcode: a knockout 130 BPM peak-time techno cut, and the second Kaufmann track today, so they pair well.
notes: Official Drumcode upload; 6:02 matches Beatport (6:01). The 3:46 Topic version is an edit.

title: Circus
label: Magnifik Music
chart_source: Beatport Melodic House & Techno Top 100 #12

notes: Official Topic upload of the full 6:24 (Beatport 6:23). Magnifik's own 4:32 upload (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=czdGbyf56YU) is an edit.
